definition_formula: Sum of recognized transaction value after cancellations as defined by finance
required_dimensions: market; domain; channel; page; product/service; new/returning; cohort
red_flag: Material decline outside seasonality or tracking mismatch
diagnosis: Separate demand, conversion, price/AOV, fulfilment and attribution effects
improvement_action: Repair measurement; recover funnel; improve qualified demand, offer, CVR, AOV or retention
do_not: Use GA4 revenue as sole finance truth

definition_formula: Revenue minus variable product, fulfilment, payment, return, media and service costs
red_flag: Revenue grows while contribution falls
diagnosis: Check discounting, returns, shipping, media and support costs
improvement_action: Prioritize profitable products/segments and improve price/operations
do_not: Optimize ROAS or revenue without margin

definition_formula: Revenue / eligible sessions
required_dimensions: market; device; channel; landing page; new/returning
red_flag: Traffic rises while RPS falls materially
diagnosis: Decompose into CVR and AOV; inspect traffic quality
improvement_action: Improve intent match, funnel and merchandising
do_not: Celebrate traffic growth without commercial yield

definition_formula: Qualified leads / eligible sessions or submitted leads; state denominator
red_flag: Lead volume rises but qualification falls
diagnosis: Audit acquisition intent, form, routing and qualification criteria
improvement_action: Refine audience, message, form and follow-up
do_not: Optimize raw form fills

definition_formula: Won customers / qualified leads
required_dimensions: market; source; landing page; service; sales owner; cohort
red_flag: Material drop or unexplained source/page variance
diagnosis: Inspect lead quality, response time, sales process and offer
improvement_action: Improve routing, enablement, proof, offer and nurture
do_not: Attribute loss to website without pipeline evidence

definition_formula: Acquisition cost / new customers using agreed blended or channel definition
red_flag: CAC exceeds payback or rises with lower quality
diagnosis: Separate media, agency, discount and sales costs
improvement_action: Improve demand quality, conversion, retention and cost efficiency
do_not: Compare CAC with different definitions

definition_formula: Expected or realized contribution over defined customer horizon
required_dimensions: cohort; market; acquisition source; product; customer type
red_flag: LTV:CAC below approved threshold or cohort deterioration
diagnosis: Inspect repeat interval, retention, margin and returns
improvement_action: Lifecycle, service, subscription/reorder, cross-sell, referral
do_not: Use gross revenue LTV without cost/horizon

definition_formula: Own category revenue or units / total category revenue or units
red_flag: No reliable denominator or declining share despite market growth
diagnosis: Validate category boundary and denominator
improvement_action: Focus on specific segment/channel/region attack
do_not: Present traffic share as actual market share

definition_formula: Brand search interest / total selected brand search interest
required_dimensions: region; period; device if available; brand set
red_flag: Brand set unstable or index treated as absolute volume
diagnosis: Check seasonality, campaigns, category demand and media
improvement_action: Grow distinctive demand and category association
do_not: Claim causal market share from one index

definition_formula: Estimated visits to own domain / selected competitor-set visits
red_flag: Large gap in strategic channel or sudden unexplained loss
diagnosis: Inspect channel mix, site changes and competitor campaigns
improvement_action: Build channel-specific acquisition and retention plan
do_not: Use estimate as audited revenue

definition_formula: Clicks reported by Search Console
required_dimensions: query; page; country; device; search appearance; date
target_method: OWN seasonal baseline and opportunity forecast
red_flag: Priority page/cluster decline beyond guardrail
diagnosis: Decompose impressions, CTR, position, SERP/AI feature and indexation
improvement_action: Fix eligibility, intent, snippet, content, authority or migration defects
do_not: Compare GSC clicks directly to GA4 sessions

definition_formula: Search result impressions under GSC definition
required_dimensions: query; page; country; device; appearance; date
red_flag: Loss across priority pages/regions
diagnosis: Check demand, indexation, ranking, cannibalisation and SERP changes
improvement_action: Improve eligibility, coverage, content and authority
do_not: Treat impressions as visits

definition_formula: GSC clicks / impressions
required_dimensions: query; page; position band; device; country; appearance
red_flag: Low against own comparable cohort, not generic average
diagnosis: Inspect title, snippet, intent, brand, rich result and SERP layout
improvement_action: Rewrite/search appearance tests while preserving relevance
do_not: Use one global CTR benchmark

definition_formula: Sum(search volume x visibility/CTR model) / total selected demand
target_method: PEER median then upper quartile in priority clusters
red_flag: Priority-cluster SOV materially below direct peers
diagnosis: Separate coverage, rank, SERP features and query mix
improvement_action: Close content/technical/authority gaps by cluster
do_not: Mix unrelated keywords or locations

definition_formula: Priority keywords ranking in bands / tracked priority keywords
red_flag: High demand remains outside page 1 or wrong page ranks
diagnosis: Check intent/page fit, authority and cannibalisation
improvement_action: Improve/merge page, links, content and SERP fit
do_not: Report rank count without demand/value

definition_formula: Canonical 200 HTML URLs eligible for indexation
target_method: Equals approved inventory within explained variance
red_flag: Unplanned growth/decline or noncanonical URLs indexable
diagnosis: Inspect generation rules, directives, canonicals, filters
improvement_action: Correct templates, parameters, sitemaps and internal links
do_not: Maximize indexed pages

definition_formula: Indexed priority canonical URLs / submitted priority URLs
target_method: Near 100% for eligible high-value stable pages after reasonable discovery period
red_flag: Priority pages excluded, alternate canonical or crawled-not-indexed
diagnosis: Check quality, canonical, internal links, rendering, duplication and server
improvement_action: Fix root cause and resubmit naturally
do_not: Demand instant indexing or use Indexing API improperly

definition_formula: URLs where declared, sitemap, internal-link and Google-selected canonical agree / checked URLs
red_flag: Google selects unexpected canonical
diagnosis: Inspect duplication, redirects, internal links, hreflang and content parity
improvement_action: Align all canonical signals
do_not: Treat rel=canonical as guaranteed directive

definition_formula: Valid canonical indexable 200 URLs / sitemap URLs
red_flag: Any systematic invalid URLs or false lastmod
diagnosis: Inspect generator, inventory, status, canonical and lastmod logic
improvement_action: Fix sitemap generation and inventory
do_not: Use sitemap as navigation dump

definition_formula: Low-value/duplicate/parameter bot requests / total bot requests; definition documented
target_method: Trend down without blocking useful discovery
red_flag: High requests to infinite facets/parameters/errors
diagnosis: Classify bot demand by URL purpose and trace generation/internal-link sources
improvement_action: Fix generation, links, parameters, status and crawl controls
do_not: Block before understanding discovery/indexation impact

definition_formula: Priority URLs with at least required contextual/nav inlinks / priority URLs
target_method: 100% priority pages; depth target by architecture
red_flag: Orphans, deep high-value pages or links through redirects
diagnosis: Map authority and user journeys
improvement_action: Add meaningful crawlable contextual links and update destinations
do_not: Add sitewide keyword-stuffed links

definition_formula: Previously valuable pages with sustained clicks/revenue decline / valuable pages
red_flag: Decline unexplained by seasonality/demand
diagnosis: Check SERP intent, freshness, competitors, cannibalisation and technical changes
improvement_action: Refresh, consolidate, improve evidence or retire deliberately
do_not: Change publication date without substantive update

definition_formula: Relevant domains linking to peers but not own site
target_method: Close relevant feasible gaps; build unique assets
red_flag: Competitors earn authoritative deep links while own links cluster on homepage
diagnosis: Review linked assets and relationship paths
improvement_action: Create original research/tools/PR and reclaim links
do_not: Bulk outreach, paid link schemes, chase DA

definition_formula: Backlinked source URLs resolving to error/irrelevant redirect and estimated value
red_flag: High-authority links lost in migration
diagnosis: Check original intent, content replacement, redirect chain and live status
improvement_action: Restore or one-hop redirect to closest intent
do_not: Redirect everything to homepage

definition_formula: Impressions in GSC generative AI report where available
red_flag: Priority pages lose visibility or inaccurate pages appear
diagnosis: Check eligibility, content usefulness, authority and query fan-out coverage
improvement_action: Improve original expert content and technical/search foundations
do_not: Assume report is available for all properties

definition_formula: Own brand mentioned / valid prompt runs
required_dimensions: model; version; prompt; persona; market; language; date
red_flag: Competitors dominate qualified recommendation prompts
diagnosis: Audit cited sources, reputation, product fit and factual clarity
improvement_action: Improve source ecosystem, product evidence and authoritative content
do_not: Treat stochastic runs as stable rankings

definition_formula: Own domains cited / total citations in controlled prompt set
red_flag: Mentions without citations or wrong pages cited
diagnosis: Assess page eligibility, unique evidence and third-party source presence
improvement_action: Create cite-worthy evidence and fix entity/page clarity
do_not: Manufacture inauthentic mentions or special Google AI files

definition_formula: Accurate material claims about brand/offering / checked material claims
red_flag: Wrong price, location, claims, availability or credentials
diagnosis: Find source of incorrect information and data inconsistency
improvement_action: Correct owned/third-party data; publish authoritative facts
do_not: Spam AI systems or fabricate sources

definition_formula: Priority/internal URLs returning unexpected 4xx/5xx / checked URLs
red_flag: Any broken conversion/priority page; rising 5xx
diagnosis: Trace link, route, server, deployment and generation cause
improvement_action: Fix link/route/server; monitor
do_not: Redirect all errors to homepage

definition_formula: Redirecting URLs requiring >1 hop / redirecting URLs
target_method: 0 for internal links and migration map where controllable
red_flag: Chains/loops on traffic/backlink paths
diagnosis: Trace protocol/host/path/plugin layers
improvement_action: One-hop redirect and update internal/campaign links
do_not: Stack redirects indefinitely

definition_formula: Priority content/links/meta present in rendered output and accessible without interaction
red_flag: Main content/canonical/schema/links differ or fail
diagnosis: Inspect JS errors, hydration, API, blocked resources
improvement_action: SSR/prerender or reliable rendering; real href links
do_not: Assume Google always renders successfully

definition_formula: 75th percentile Largest Contentful Paint
red_flag: Priority template poor or regression
diagnosis: Break into TTFB, resource delay, load duration, render delay
improvement_action: Optimize server, LCP resource discovery/size/priority and rendering
do_not: Use one Lighthouse score as field truth

definition_formula: 75th percentile Interaction to Next Paint
red_flag: Priority template poor or long interaction tails
diagnosis: Inspect long tasks, JS, event handlers and rendering
improvement_action: Reduce main-thread work, split tasks, optimize interactions
do_not: Replace INP with TBT field interpretation

definition_formula: 75th percentile Cumulative Layout Shift
red_flag: Visible shifts in hero, ads, fonts, banners
diagnosis: Use layout shift attribution and video
improvement_action: Reserve dimensions, stable inserts/fonts and component behavior
do_not: Hide shifts only in lab

definition_formula: 75th percentile server response timing under chosen RUM definition
red_flag: Material region/template regression
diagnosis: Inspect CDN, cache, origin, database, redirects
improvement_action: Caching/CDN/backend/query optimization
do_not: Use one universal TTFB target without architecture context

definition_formula: Transferred bytes and request count for controlled lab profile
red_flag: Budget breach or third-party growth
diagnosis: Attribute by first/third party and resource type
improvement_action: Compress/remove/defer, enforce budgets
do_not: Optimize bytes while harming UX/content

definition_formula: Main-thread, network, privacy and failure contribution by third party
target_method: Only approved scripts with measured value
red_flag: High CPU/network, duplicate tags, single-point failure
diagnosis: Map vendor, owner, purpose, revenue and consent
improvement_action: Remove, defer, consolidate, server-side where valid
do_not: Install tools/apps without owner or expiry

definition_formula: Successful availability/transaction checks / scheduled checks
target_method: SLA by criticality; 100% critical conversion success in release tests
red_flag: Outage, error spike or journey failure
diagnosis: Trace deployment, dependency, payment, DNS/CDN
improvement_action: Rollback/fix and add monitor
do_not: Monitor homepage only

definition_formula: Users completing defined task correctly / attempted users
target_method: Set per critical task; improve vs baseline/peer test
red_flag: Critical task failure or high assistance
diagnosis: Observe navigation, comprehension and errors
improvement_action: Fix IA, labels, content and interactions
do_not: Substitute stakeholder preference for user test

definition_formula: Time from task start to verified completion among successful attempts
target_method: OWN baseline and context, not always lower
red_flag: Long time plus confusion/errors
diagnosis: Inspect path and cognitive load
improvement_action: Simplify steps, labels and defaults
do_not: Optimize speed if deliberation is necessary

definition_formula: Attempts encountering specified severe error / attempts
red_flag: Payment/form/search/navigation failure
diagnosis: Reproduce and classify design/content/technical cause
improvement_action: Fix and regression-test
do_not: Average away severe errors

definition_formula: Search sessions leading to relevant click/desired outcome / search sessions
target_method: OWN baseline; zero-result target near 0 for important queries
red_flag: High zero-result, reformulation or exit
diagnosis: Analyze synonyms, catalog, ranking, filters and UI
improvement_action: Improve indexing, synonyms, merchandising and result design
do_not: Hide search to avoid poor metrics

definition_formula: Applicable WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria passed
red_flag: Any blocker for critical journey; critical/serious automated issue
diagnosis: Manual keyboard, screen reader, zoom, focus, contrast and forms
improvement_action: Fix design system and code; retest with assistive tech
do_not: Claim conformance from automated score alone

definition_formula: Primary conversions / eligible sessions or users; denominator fixed
red_flag: Decline outside guardrail or low vs qualified peer cohort
diagnosis: Decompose intent, message, UX, performance, trust, offer and operations
improvement_action: Research then test highest-confidence constraint
do_not: Apply generic 2-3% benchmark to every funnel

definition_formula: Defined page conversions / landing sessions under fixed attribution
target_method: Use own control; UB median 6.6% only broad context [UB01]
red_flag: Below own comparable control or unit economics
diagnosis: Check traffic mix, message match, offer, proof, friction and tracking
improvement_action: Preserve control; run valid test
do_not: Redesign and overwrite control

definition_formula: Qualified primary CTA clicks / eligible page views
red_flag: High clicks but low completion or low clicks with strong intent
diagnosis: Inspect clarity, prominence, wording, placement, next-step expectation
improvement_action: Improve hierarchy/message and verify downstream
do_not: Optimize clicks without conversion quality

definition_formula: Successful valid submissions / form starts
red_flag: High drop at field/error or CRM mismatch
diagnosis: Analyze field necessity, errors, trust, technical delivery
improvement_action: Reduce friction, improve validation, preserve data and test routing
do_not: Remove qualification fields without sales impact analysis

definition_formula: Add-to-cart events / product-detail sessions or product viewers
target_method: OWN cohort and product-type peer context
red_flag: High PDP traffic with low add or high add with low checkout
diagnosis: Inspect product fit, availability, price, content, variants and event validity
improvement_action: Improve PDP, offer, merchandising and inventory
do_not: Assume lower rate is always UX

definition_formula: Completed orders / checkout starts
red_flag: Drop by step/payment/market
diagnosis: Inspect costs, errors, methods, trust, address and fulfilment
improvement_action: Fix checkout friction, costs and payment reliability
do_not: Count payment retries as independent users

definition_formula: 1 - completed purchases / carts or checkout starts; definition stated
target_method: OWN baseline; Baymard ~70% broad context, not target [BM02]
red_flag: Material increase or segment anomaly
diagnosis: Separate browse/cart/checkout abandonment and intentional research
improvement_action: Fix hidden costs, trust, delivery, errors and recovery
do_not: Use one abandonment definition across tools

definition_formula: Returned/refunded units or value / fulfilled units or value
red_flag: CVR rises with returns/complaints
diagnosis: Analyze expectation mismatch, quality, sizing, damage and fraud
improvement_action: Improve content/product/fulfilment and suppress bad acquisition
do_not: Optimize purchase conversion alone

definition_formula: Sales-qualified leads / marketing-qualified leads
red_flag: MQL volume up, SQL rate down
diagnosis: Audit scoring, audience, content, routing and SLA
improvement_action: Refine ICP, qualification and handoff
do_not: Use MQL definition inconsistently

definition_formula: Opportunity amount under documented sourcing/influence model
red_flag: Content claims revenue without model consistency
diagnosis: Separate sourced, influenced and assisted
improvement_action: Improve account journey and attribution
do_not: Double count influenced revenue

definition_formula: Time from valid inquiry to first meaningful response
red_flag: SLA breach or high-value lead unowned
diagnosis: Trace routing, staffing and notifications
improvement_action: Automate routing/escalation and staff coverage
do_not: Promise response time not operationally supported

definition_formula: Observed grid/keyword visibility points won / eligible points
target_method: PEER by location; selected priority areas
red_flag: Weak near actual service area or wrong landing/profile
diagnosis: Check GBP, proximity, relevance, prominence, reviews and page
improvement_action: Improve profile, local page, reviews, citations and local authority
do_not: Create spam locations or fake addresses

definition_formula: Rating, volume, velocity, recency, topic and response SLA
red_flag: Negative topic spike, low response or authenticity concern
diagnosis: Analyze operational causes and response process
improvement_action: Fix service and request authentic reviews
do_not: Buy, gate or fabricate reviews

definition_formula: Valid reciprocal locale annotations / intended locale URLs
target_method: 100% intended URLs; no invalid/missing return tags
red_flag: Wrong-language results or cluster errors
diagnosis: Check canonical, status, return links and locale codes
improvement_action: Fix generated annotations and sitemap/html strategy
do_not: Use hreflang to canonicalize duplicates

definition_formula: Sessions reaching wrong locale/currency/availability experience / evaluated sessions
red_flag: High switchbacks, unavailable products or forced redirect complaints
diagnosis: Inspect geo detection, links, ads, search results and selector persistence
improvement_action: Use stable locale URLs and clear selector
do_not: Forced opaque redirects or IP-only content

definition_formula: Material linguistic/functional defects / reviewed units
red_flag: Legal/medical/product meaning errors or broken UI
diagnosis: Classify source, glossary, context and layout failures
improvement_action: Fix source terminology, translation memory and review
do_not: Publish raw machine translation for high-risk content

definition_formula: Confirmed critical exploitable findings under approved severity method
target_method: 0 open critical at release; OWASP 2025 baseline [O01]
red_flag: Any exploitable access/control/injection/supply-chain issue
diagnosis: Validate exploitability and asset impact
improvement_action: Patch, mitigate, retest and monitor
do_not: Publish sensitive vulnerability details prematurely

definition_formula: Successful verified restoration / scheduled restoration tests
red_flag: Backups exist but cannot restore within objective
diagnosis: Test full chain, credentials and dependencies
improvement_action: Fix backup, runbook and recovery architecture
do_not: Treat backup job success as restore proof

definition_formula: Closed items with required implementation/retest artifacts / closed items
red_flag: Tickets closed without live proof
diagnosis: Check missing commit, deploy, test, report or approval
improvement_action: Reopen until definition of done is met
do_not: Accept screenshot alone for hidden configuration

definition_formula: Deployments causing rollback, incident or material regression / deployments
red_flag: Repeated regression by same component
diagnosis: Root-cause and missing gate/test
improvement_action: Add automated controls and smaller releases
do_not: Hide failed releases from denominator
